messages:
maria_cs: Hey — vendor asked for an "export controls" section as part of the DPA renewal. They specifically want the encryption algorithms we use, KMS provider details, whether we support BYOK, and any FIPS/compliance statements. Need a response to send back today.

 devon_security: Quick clarifying q — is this about cross-border data export or export-controlled cryptography (ECC/RSA export regs)? Sounds like cryptography control.

 maria_cs: They quoted: 'Please describe export compliance for encryption, list of cryptographic modules and any operational restrictions.' So yeah, crypto.

 devon_security: Ok. Proposed high-level response: 1) Algorithms: AES-256-GCM for data at rest, TLS1.2+ (AES-GCM) in transit. 2) KMS: Hosted uses AWS KMS; Dedicated/Private customers can configure BYOK via customer-managed KMS or HSM. 3) FIPS: Our managed KMS provider offers FIPS-validated endpoints in select regions — we can reference vendor certs. 4) Export law note: customers are responsible for compliance; we provide technical controls.

 sam_onboard: For the specific customer (they're asking during onboarding), they want an attestation that keys never leave their HSM when BYOK is used. Can we confirm that?

 oliver_engineering: Implementation detail: when BYOK is configured for Private we support wrapped-key import into CloudHSM or external HSM via KMIP; key material stays within the HSM domain and we do not export plaintext keys. For hosted, by default we manage keys (no customer key export).

 oliver_engineering: Example config snippet we can include:
 ```
 kms_provider: aws
 region: us-west-2
 byok: true
 hsm_mode: cloudhsm
 key_wrapping: rsa-oaep
 ```

 devon_security: We'll also need to provide a redacted key-rotation log (showing rotations but not raw key material) and pointer to the KMS vendor's FIPS certificates. Legal wants a sentence that limits our attestation: we attest to the behavior of our integrations but customers are responsible for their own export compliance.

 maria_cs: Can someone assemble a 1-page attestation + the redacted rotation entries and the link to vendor certs? I'll send to the vendor. If legal needs to edit wording, ping me.

 ops-bot: Created ticket CS-4128 - vendor-export-attestation. Assigned to devon_security, oliver_engineering.

 devon_security: I'll draft the attestation and loop in Legal for sign-off. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PT.

 maria_cs: Perfect — thanks. Once legal signs, I'll send it and close the loop with the customer. :thumbsup: 

 sam_onboard: If legal suggests tight wording, we should also prepare a fallback: a checkboxed list (what we can guarantee vs what is customer responsibility) to reduce negotiation friction.

 maria_cs: Agreed — include that in the one-pager.

 oliver_engineering: Noted — I'll drop the redacted rotation log and the config example into CS-4128 now.

 maria_cs: TY!
